blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Online hate speech is an ever-growing issue with negative impacts on both groups and individuals, potentially causing users to withdraw from online conversations and debate. With some prominent social media platforms reducing their moderation efforts, constructive speech has emerged as an alternative strategy for countering hate. Automated detection of constructive and hateful speech can aid monitoring and improve understanding of their prevalence and online dynamics. In this work, we collect and annotate a large dataset of English and Danish social media comments for hateful tone, constructive tone, and agreement with parent comments. We fine-tune several multilingual LLMs to classify along these three dimensions and compare context-enriched and non-context-enriched model architectures. The E5-large LLM performs best on both the context-enriched (82% average F1) and non-context-enriched (81.6% average F1) classification tasks, demonstrating the potential of multilingual LLMs for scalable detection of hateful and constructive speech across languages.
blocks.zh: 网络仇恨言论是一个日益严重的问题,对团体和个人都有负面影响,可能导致用户退出网络对话和辩论。 随着一些有名的社交媒体平台减少其温和的努力,建设性言论也成为了反仇恨的替代战略。 自动发现建设性和可憎的言论有助于监测和增进对其普遍性和在线动态的了解。 在这部作品中,我们收集并注释大量英语和丹麦社交媒体评论的数据集,以表达仇恨的语调,建设性语调,并赞同家长的评论. 我们微调了几种多语言的LLMs,以按照这三个方面进行分类,并比较内容丰富和内容不丰富的模式结构。 E5级大型LLM在内容丰富(平均为82%的F1级)和非内容丰富(平均为81.6%的F1级)的分类任务上表现得最好,显示出多种语言的LLM对跨语言的仇恨和建设性言论进行可扩展检测的潜力。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Online spaces are an important part of everyday life in the 21st century. Approximately two-thirds of the world’s population uses social media, and this number continues to grow ( Kemp, 2022 ) . Though online conversations can serve as healthy forums for sharing, expressing, interacting, and debating across countries and cultures, they can also foster hate speech harming individuals and groups. A UNESCO ( 2025 ) report reveals that 67% of internet users have encountered hate speech online.
In 2023, nearly half (49%) of young active internet users aged 16–29 in EU countries reported encountering hostile or degrading messages online, with Denmark recording the second-highest share at 68%. Furthermore, among this age group, “political or social views” was the most frequently cited reason for why individuals or groups were targeted, accounting for 35% across the EU. This category was particularly prominent in Estonia (60%), followed by Finland (56%) and Denmark (49%) ( Eurostat, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
在线空间是21世纪日常生活的重要组成部分. 大约三分之二的世界人口使用社交媒体,而且这一数字继续增长(Kemp,2022年)。 网络对话虽然可以作为各国和文化之间交流、表达、互动和辩论的健康论坛,但也能够助长伤害个人和群体的仇恨言论。 教科文组织(2025年)的一份报告显示,67%的互联网用户在网上遇到仇恨言论。
在2023年,欧盟国家16至29岁年轻活跃的互联网用户中,近一半(49%)报告说在网上遇到敌对或有辱人格的信息,丹麦记录的第二高份额为68%。 此外,在这一年龄组中,“政治或社会观点”是最常被引用的个人或群体成为目标的原因,在整个欧盟占35%。 这一类别在爱沙尼亚尤为突出(60%),其次是芬兰(56%)和丹麦(49%)(欧统局,2024年)。

blocks.en: Exposure to online hate and violent content has several negative personal and societal consequences. At the individual level, it is associated with lower well-being ( Oksanen et al., 2014 ) and happiness ( Keipi et al., 2018 ) , as well as increased aggression ( Anderson and Bushman, 2001 ) and reduced empathy ( Funk et al., 2004 ) . It can also lead to stress ( Saha et al., 2019 ) , distress ( Leets, 2002 ) , sadness ( Reichelmann et al., 2021 ; Keighley, 2022 ) , and depressive symptoms ( Madriaza et al., 2025 ) . At the societal level, online hate speech discourages participation in public discourse. As more and more individuals withdraw from debates ( Marzęda, 2025 ; Gelber and McNamara, 2016 ; Chen, 2017 ) , distance themselves from online spaces ( Pabian et al., 2026 ) , or engage in self-censorship ( Celuch et al., 2024 ) , the democratic potential of online spaces is threatened, as these forums become more and more polarized ( Kim et al., 2021 ) . Such concerns are also reflected in current policy debates about particularly young people’s use of social media. For instance, Australia has in 2024 introduced a minimum age requirement for social media use ( Australia, 2024 ) , and similar discussions have emerged in Denmark and the EU more generally.
blocks.zh: 网上仇恨和暴力内容的曝光具有若干负面的个人和社会后果。 在个人层面,它与较低的福利(Oksanen等人,2014年)和幸福(Keipi等人,2018年)有关,并且与侵略增加(Anderson和Bushman,2001年)和同情减少(Funk等人,2004年)有关。 这也会导致压力(Saha等人,2019年),危难(Lets,2002年),悲伤(Reichelmann等人,2021年;Keighley,2022年),以及抑郁症(Madriaza等人,2025年). 在社会层面,网上仇恨言论不利于参与公共言论。 随着越来越多的个人退出辩论(Marzęda,2025年;Gelber和McNamara,2016年;Chen,2017年),与网络空间保持距离(Pabian等人,2026年),或参与自我审查(Celuch等人,2024年),网络空间的民主潜力受到威胁,因为这些论坛变得越来越两极化(Kim等人,2021年). 这种关切也反映在目前关于年轻人使用社交媒体的政策辩论中。 例如,澳大利亚在2024年对社交媒体的使用规定了最低年龄要求(澳大利亚,2024年),在丹麦和欧盟也出现了类似的讨论。

blocks.en: While most users scroll by or withdraw from hateful content ( Vogels, 2021 ) , others choose to act against it in various ways ( Hansen et al., 2023 ) . One of the most promising bystander reactions for reducing the negative impact of online hate is counterspeech, i.e., written responses to aiming to counter hateful content. Counterspeech can take different forms, with research suggesting varying effectiveness at reducing future hostility ( Hangartner et al., 2021 ; Gennaro et al., 2025b ; Lasser et al., 2025 ) . In this work, we distinguish between constructive and non-constructive forms of counterspeech, with constructive counterspeech defined as responding in a generally prosocial way. In particular, constructive counterspeech seeks to challenge hate by signaling its disapproval, and/or siding with, shielding, or comforting an individual victim or victimized group. This can be achieved in various ways, such as trying to evoke empathy, calling out hateful behavior, correcting misperceptions, or generally calling for a better culture of debate ( Hansen et al., 2023 ) . Research has shown that constructive counterspeech is more effective than non-constructive (e.g., hateful or ridiculing) forms of counterspeech ( Albanyan et al., 2023 ; Alyahya and Aldayel, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 虽然大多数用户通过仇恨内容滚动或退出(Vogels,2021年),但其他人选择以各种方式反对(Hansen等人,2023年). 减少网络仇恨负面影响的最有希望的旁观者反应之一是反言论,即对旨在抵制仇恨内容的书面答复。 Counterspeech可以采取不同形式,研究表明在减少未来的敌意方面效果不同(Hangartner等人,2021年;Gennaro等人,2025年b;Lasser等人,2025年)。 在这项工作中,我们区分了建设性和非建设性形式的反言论,建设性反言论的定义是,以普遍有利于社会的方式作出反应。 特别是,建设性的反言论试图通过表示反对仇恨和/或支持、保护或安慰受害者或受害群体来挑战仇恨。 这可以通过各种方式实现,例如试图引起同情、喊出仇恨行为、纠正误解或普遍呼吁更好的辩论文化(Hansen等人,2023年)。 研究表明,建设性的反言论比非建设性(如仇恨或可笑)形式的反言论更有效(Albanyan等人,2023年;Alyahya和Aldayel,2025年)。

blocks.en: Understanding (constructive) counterspeech is particularly important in a time of growing platform reluctance toward moderation practices. In early 2025, Meta announced a shift toward greater emphasis on free expression and reduced content moderation ( Kaplan, 2025 ) , adopting an approach similar to that of X ( X Corp., 2024 ) . In contrast, a large share of internet users believe that hate speech should be addressed by social media platforms themselves ( Ipsos and UNESCO, 2023 ) . In this context, crowd-sourced moderation through counterspeech may become increasingly important.
blocks.zh: 理解(建设性)反言论在日益不愿采取节制做法的平台上特别重要。 Meta在2025年初宣布转向更多强调自由表达和减少内容温和度(Kaplan, 2025年), 网民认为仇恨言论应该由社交媒体平台自己处理(Ipsos和UNESCO,2023年), 在这方面,通过反言论进行众包温和可能变得越来越重要。

blocks.en: To understand these online dynamics, it is necessary to monitor both hate speech and various forms of counterspeech at scale. Natural language processing (NLP) methods offer a promising approach for automatically detecting such content, enabling researchers to examine the prevalence of hate and constructive speech, as well as whether constructive speech improves online discussions. To enable such analysis, we introduce a multilingual, multidimensional classifier that jointly labels texts for hate speech, constructive speech, and agreement with parent comments.
blocks.zh: 为了了解这些在线动态,必须大规模地监测仇恨言论和各种形式的反言论。 自然语言处理方法(NLP)为自动检测此类内容提供了一个很有希望的方法,使研究人员能够审查仇恨和建设性言论的普遍程度,以及建设性言论是否改善在线讨论。 为了能够进行这种分析,我们引入了一个多语种、多维分类法,将文本标注为仇恨言论、建设性言论和与父母意见一致。

blocks.en: 1.1 Our Contribution
blocks.zh: 1.1 我们的贡献

blocks.en: In this work, we collect and annotate a large dataset of English (a high-resource language) and Danish (a mid-to-low-resource language) Joshi et al. (2020) social media comments along three dimensions: hateful (yes/no/unclassifiable), constructive speech (yes/no/unclassifiable), and agreement (agree/disagree/unclear). We fine-tune four multilingual LLMs for the two detection setups (context-enriched and non-context-enriched), and conduct a comparative evaluation across models.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们收集并注释大量英文(高资源语言)和丹麦文(中低资源语言)的数据集Joshi等人(2020年)社交媒体在三个方面的评论:仇恨(是/否/不可分类)、建设性言论(是/否/不可分类)和协议(同意/不同意/不明确)。 我们微调了四个多语言的LLMs,用于两个检测设置(内容浓缩和非内容浓缩),并进行跨模型的比较评价。

blocks.en: This is, to the best of our knowledge, the first study to jointly model hate speech, constructive speech, and agreement in a multidimensional and non-exclusive framework, allowing instances to, simultaneously express hate and constructive speech. However, a similar idea has been explored by Albanyan and Blanco (2022) , albeit with a more narrowly focused approach.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,这是在多层面和非排他性框架内联合模拟仇恨言论、建设性言论和协议的第一项研究,它允许事件同时表达仇恨和建设性言论。 然而,Albanyan和Blanco(2022年)也探索了类似的想法,尽管采用了较为狭隘的重点方法.

blocks.en: Together, the three dimensions allow the tracking of the precise dynamics of hate and (constructive) counterspeech as they unfold in online comment sections, using just a single classification model. Furthermore, this work introduces the first annotated dataset and constructive speech classification model in Danish, addressing a key gap in research on mid-to-low-resource languages.
blocks.zh: 这三个维度加在一起,可以追踪仇恨和(建设性)反言论在在线评论部分的准确动态,仅使用单一的分类模型。 此外,这项工作引入了丹麦语的第一个附加说明的数据集和建设性的语音分类模型,解决了中低资源语言研究中的一个关键差距。

blocks.en: 2 Previous Work
blocks.zh: 2 以往的工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Challenges in automated detection
blocks.zh: 2.1 自动检测方面的挑战

blocks.en: Automatically detecting hate speech remains a challenging task. Hate speech is often ambiguous and highly dependent on context, making it difficult to distinguish between genuinely hateful content and harmless uses of similar language ( Wilson and Land, 2020 ; Markov and Daelemans, 2022 ; Sheth et al., 2022 ) . In addition, hateful expressions continuously evolve through new slang, coded language, and platform-specific conventions Pérez et al. (2023) . As a result, effective detection cannot rely solely on the presence of profanity or offensive keywords (explicit hate), but should ideally also detect more implicit or subtle forms of hate Gao and Huang (2017) . Detection systems used in, for example, moderation must also balance the identification of harmful content with the protection of legitimate expression, reflecting broader tensions between content regulation and free speech.
blocks.zh: 自动发现仇恨言论仍然是一项艰巨的任务。 仇恨言论往往模棱两可,高度依赖背景,因此很难区分真正仇恨的内容和类似语言的无害使用(Wilson and Land, 2020年;Markov and Daelemans, 2022年;Sheth等人, 2022年). 此外,仇恨的表达方式通过新的朗语、编码语言和平台专用公约Pérez等人(2023年)不断演变。 因此,有效侦测不能仅仅依靠存在亵渎或攻击性关键词(明显的仇恨),最好还应发现更隐含或微妙的仇恨形式高和黄(2017年). 例如,节制中使用的侦测系统还必须在识别有害内容和保护合法表达之间取得平衡,反映内容监管与言论自由之间更广泛的紧张关系。

blocks.en:
Detecting constructive speech and other forms of pro-social speech presents similar challenges. Definitions of constructive speech are inherently subjective, and responses perceived as constructive by some users may be viewed as condescending, hostile, or ineffective by others Ping et al. (2025) .
Furthermore, interpretations of constructive communication vary across cultural and social contexts, complicating the development of consistent annotation schemes and automated detection systems Fesaghandis and Maity (2026a) ; Fesaghandis and Maity (2026b) .
blocks.zh:
检测建设性言论和其他形式的亲社会言论也提出了类似的挑战。 建设性言论的定义本质上是主观的,一些用户认为具有建设性的反应可能被其他Ping等人(2025年)视为屈尊、敌对或无效。
此外,对建设性交流的解释因文化和社会背景而异,使制定一致的注释计划和自动检测系统Fesaghandis和Maity(2026a);Fesaghandis和Maity(2026b)。

blocks.en: We note that, in this work, we focus on encoder-based classification models. While the field of hate speech detection has seen rapid development accompanying the ever-growing capabilities of LLMs (e.g., using decoder models as single or few-shot classifiers ( Rathje et al., 2024 ) ), the effectiveness of these approaches when compared to more classical approaches of using fine-tuned encoder models remains an open question ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , and come with their own set of issues ( Fasching and Lelkes, 2025 ) . We believe that for the foreseeable future, there remains a need for specialized lightweight models that can be run locally on smaller machines to enable the analysis of large-scale data at a reasonable speed and cost. However, we benchmark our own model against Jev ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) , a so-called "decision model" optimized to make fast text classifications. This benchmark test showed that our own fine-tuned models substantially outperformed Jev, particularly in Danish (see Appendix).
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,在这项工作中,我们侧重于基于编码器的分类模型。 虽然仇恨言论侦测领域随着LLMs能力不断增长而迅速发展(例如,使用解码器模型作为单发或几发分级器(Rathje等人,2024年)),但与使用微调编码器模型的较经典方法相比,这些方法的有效性仍然是一个有待解决的问题(Zhang等人,2025年),并带来了自己的一系列问题(Fashing和Lelkes,2025年)。 我们认为,在可预见的将来,仍然需要专门的轻量级模型,可以在较小的机器上在当地运行,以便能够以合理的速度和成本分析大规模数据。 然而,我们以Jev(TypeSafe AI,2026年)作为我们自己的模型的基准,这个所谓的"决定模型"被优化了,以快速的文本分类. 这一基准测试表明,我们自己的微调模型大大超过了Jev,特别是在丹麦语中(见附录)。

blocks.en: 2.2 Detecting Hate Speech
blocks.zh: 2.2 侦测仇恨言论

blocks.en: Detecting hate speech has been widely approached as a supervised classification problem, with methods evolving from traditional machine learning to neural networks and more recently transformer-based models ( Alkomah and Ma, 2022 ) . A large body of hate speech detection research has focused on English ( Burnap and Williams, 2016 ; Kshirsagar et al., 2018 ; Malmasi and Zampieri, 2017 , e.g.,) .
blocks.zh: 侦测仇恨言论被广泛视为受监督的分类问题, 方法从传统机器学习演变为神经网络, 大量仇恨言论侦测研究集中于英语(Burnap and Williams,2016;Kshirsagar等人,2018;Malmasi and Zampieri,2017,例如).

blocks.en: Non-English hate speech detection has also been explored, although to a more limited extent and often in language-specific settings ( Del Vigna et al., 2017 ; Pereira-Kohatsu et al., 2019 , e.g.,) .
blocks.zh: 非英语仇恨言论的检测也被探索,不过在更有限程度上,也经常在语言特定场合进行(Del Vigna等人,2017年;Pereira-Kohatsu等人,2019年,例如).

blocks.en: When exploring multilingual hate speech detection, one common approach has been to mix English with Non-English language(s) ( Ahmad et al., 2025 ; Farooqi et al., 2021 ; Mnassri et al., 2024 ; Siddiqui et al., 2024 , e.g.,) .
blocks.zh: 在探索多语种仇恨言论侦测时,一种常见的做法是将英语与非英语语言混合(Ahmad等人,2025年;Farooqi等人,2021年;Mnassri等人,2024年;Siddiqui等人,2024年,例如).

blocks.en: Hate speech detection has also been explored in Nordic languages, including Norwegian ( Hashmi and Yayilgan, 2024 ) , Swedish ( Fernquist et al., 2019 ) , and Danish ( Sigurbergsson and Derczynski, 2020 ) , although research in these languages remains more limited.
blocks.zh: 仇恨言论的探究也用北欧语言进行,包括挪威语(Hashmi and Yayilgan, 2024),瑞典语(Fernquist等人, 2019),丹麦语(Sigurbergsson and Derczynski, 2020),尽管这些语言的研究仍然比较有限.

blocks.en: 2.3 Detecting Constructive Speech
blocks.zh: 2.3 探测建设性发言

blocks.en: Detecting constructive speech remains a relatively underdeveloped NLP task, largely due to the absence of a shared definition or taxonomy and the limited availability of high-quality annotated (multilingual) datasets ( Fesaghandis and Maity, 2026a ; Mathew et al., 2019 ) .
blocks.zh: 探测建设性言论仍然是一项相对不发达的NLP任务,这主要是由于缺乏共同的定义或分类,以及缺乏高质量的(多种语言)附加说明的数据集(Fesaghandis and Maity, 2026a); Mathew等人, 2019 ).

blocks.en: Existing work has primarily focused on English data, where early studies demonstrated that constructive speech can be detected with moderate performance using supervised models ( Mathew et al., 2018 ; He et al., 2021 ; Jacobs et al., 2022 ) . Subsequent research has highlighted the importance of conversational context, with studies such by Yu et al. (2022) , Fialho et al. (2024) , or Albanyan and Blanco (2022) who incorporated preceding discourse in their classification setup (which we call context-enriched in our approach), leading to improved performance.
blocks.zh: 现有工作主要集中于英语数据,早期的研究表明,使用受监督的模型可以用适度的性能来检测建设性言论(Mathew等人,2018年;He等人,2021年;Jacobs等人,2022年). 随后的研究强调了对话背景的重要性,如Yu等人(2022年)、Fialho等人(2024年)或Albanyan和Blanco(2022年)的研究,他们将前述论述纳入了分类安排(我们称之为在方法中注重背景),从而改进了业绩。

blocks.en: Taking a different angle, some research focusses on differentiating counterspeakers from hate speakers. That is, rather than classifying a single piece of text, these studies take individual users as the focus of analysis ( Garland et al., 2020 ; Mathew et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: 从不同的角度出发,一些研究侧重于区分反言者和说仇恨的人。 也就是说,这些研究没有将单一文本分类,而是将个别用户作为分析的重点(Garland等人,2020年;Mathew等人,2020年)。

blocks.en: As perhaps the most ambitious attempt thus far in counterspeech detection, Lasser et al. (2025) trained a German classifier for counterspeech that also covers various more fine-grained counterspeech strategies (e.g., sarcasm, providing facts, offering opinions, etc.). However, since most strategies were too rare to be reliably detected, the final classifier collapses most categories into broader categories: opinion, prosocial, sarcasm, insult, or other/uninterpretable. This also echoes earlier findings by Yu et al. (2023) , who reported only moderate performance in classifying counterspeech strategies.
blocks.zh: 作为迄今为止在反言论侦测方面最雄心勃勃的尝试,Lasser等人(2025年)培训了一名德国反言论分类员,该分类员还涵盖各种更加精细的反言论策略(例如讽刺,提供事实,提供意见等). 然而,由于大多数策略太少,无法可靠地发现,最终的分类者崩溃了大多数类别,分为更广泛的类别:舆论、亲社会、讽刺、侮辱或其他/不可解释的类别。 这也与Yu等人(2023年)早先的调查结果相呼应,他们只报告在对反声策略进行分类方面表现温和.

blocks.en: However, most studies rely on data from a single social media platform, limiting the generalizability of findings across platforms. In addition, multilingual work remains limited and often focuses on a mix of small sets of high-resource languages ( Chung et al., 2019 ; Chung et al., 2021 ; Möhle et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 然而,大多数研究都依赖于单一社交媒体平台的数据,限制了发现跨平台的通用性. 此外,多语种工作仍然有限,并经常专注于组合一批小套高资源语言(Chung等人,2019年;Chung等人,2021年;Möhle等人,2023年).

blocks.en: 2.4 Limitations of Current Approaches
blocks.zh: 2.4 现行办法的局限性

blocks.en: Most existing systems for detecting constructive speech, toxicity, or hate speech operate on isolated comments without sufficient context, often classifying a single message without access to the surrounding conversation, such as the parent comment or the full thread. While a few recent studies incorporate conversational context Yu et al. (2022) ; Fialho et al. (2024) ; Albanyan and Blanco (2022) , this is still not the norm. This limitation is important because the meaning of a message often depends heavily on its context and external knowledge Sheth et al. (2022) .
blocks.zh: 大多数现有的检测建设性言论,毒性,或仇恨言论的系统运作于没有足够上下文的孤立评论上,往往将无法访问周围对话的单个信息分类,如母评论或全线. 尽管最近的一些研究纳入了对话背景:Yu等人(2022年);Fialho等人(2024年);Albanyan和Blanco(2022年),但这仍不是常规。 这一限制很重要,因为信息的含义往往在很大程度上取决于其上下文和外部知识Sheth等人(2022年)。

blocks.en: Furthermore, there is currently a lack of comprehensive models that capture the full dynamics of online discourse, as most existing work focuses on binary or single-label classification. In particular, hate speech and constructive speech are often studied separately, despite representing related aspects of interaction within the same conversational context. Jointly modelling these dimensions may improve computational efficiency and classification robustness by allowing the model to leverage shared information across related tasks Collobert and Weston (2008) , while also enabling more comprehensive large-scale analyses of online discourse.
blocks.zh: 此外,目前缺乏能够充分反映在线言论动态的全面模式,因为大多数现有工作侧重于二进制或单一标签分类。 尤其是,仇恨言论和建设性言论往往单独研究,尽管它们代表了在同一对话背景下互动的有关方面。 联合建模这些层面可以提高计算效率和分类稳健性,使该模型能够利用在科洛伯特和韦斯顿(2008年)相关任务中共享的信息,同时也能够对在线言论进行更全面的大规模分析。

blocks.en: Closest to our work is Albanyan and Blanco (2022) , who classify replies to hateful tweets hierarchically: first as agreeing or disagreeing with the hateful parent, then, if disagreeing, whether they justify the disagreement or attack the author, and, if agreeing, whether they add further hate. Our approach differs in three ways. First, our labels apply to every comment in a conversation tree, including the source post, whereas their scheme labels only replies to hate and cannot detect initial hateful comments. Second, every dimension includes an unclassifiable label, so spam and incomprehensible comments are handled explicitly rather than forced into a yes/no decision ( Lasser et al., 2025 , see also) . Finally, their model has not been released and, given X’s restricted API, cannot easily be retrained.
blocks.zh: 与我们作品最接近的是Albanyan和Blanco(2022年), 他们将仇恨微博的回答分级分类:首先是同意或不同意仇恨的父母, 我们的方法有三种不同。 首先,我们的标签适用于对话树上的每一个评论,包括源头帖子,而他们的图案标签只针对仇恨,无法发现最初的仇恨评论。 其次,每个维度都包含一个不可分类的标签,因此垃圾邮件和不可理解的评论被明确处理,而不是被迫作出是/否的决定(Lasser等人,2025年,另见)。 最后,他们的型号还没有被发布,并且由于QQ限制的API,无法轻易重新训练.

blocks.en: In sum, we present a dataset and model that jointly capture multiple aspects of online interaction, including hateful, constructive, and agreement-related content. This allows for a nuanced and non-exclusive characterization of user behavior within social media conversations, while supporting context-aware and scalable analysis across languages and platforms.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们提供了一个数据集和模型,共同捕捉在线互动的多个方面,包括仇恨、建设性和协议相关内容。 这使得在社交媒体对话中可以对用户行为进行细微的和非排他性定性,同时支持跨语言和平台的上下文感和可扩展分析.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Data Collection
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 数据收集

blocks.en: The dataset consists of pairs of texts (social media comments). The first text (called the reference text) can be any kind of text, such as a top-level post, a reply, or a quote tweet. The second text (the reply text) is always a reply to the reference text. For the non-context-enriched model, only the reply text is used as input. For the context-enriched model, both the reference text and the reply text, combined with a [SEP] token, are used as input.
blocks.zh: 数据集由对文本(社交媒体评论)组成. 第一个文本(称为参考文本)可以是任何类型的文本,如顶级帖子,回复,或引文微博. 第二个案文(答复案文)始终是对参考案文的答复。 对于非文本浓缩模型,仅使用回复文本作为输入。 对于内容丰富的模型,参考文本和答复文本以及[SEP]符号都用作投入。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Example of training input for context-enriched vs non-context-enriched models.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 内容丰富与内容不丰富模式的培训投入实例。

blocks.en: We aimed to include texts in multiple languages, sourced from different platforms and covering a wide range of topics to create a diverse and appropriate dataset for annotation. Data was collected from Twitter (now X), Reddit, and Gab 1 1 1 Gab is a far-right social media platform founded in 2016 that positions itself as a free-speech alternative to mainstream networks, known for minimal content moderation and for a user base that includes many extremist communities. .
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是纳入多种语言文本,这些文本来自不同的平台,涵盖广泛的专题,以创建用于注释的多样和适当的数据集。 数据来自Twitter(现为X),Reddit,Gab 11 1 Gab是一个极右的社交媒体平台,成立于2016年,定位为主流网络的自由言论替代,以内容温和度最低和包括许多极端主义社群的用户基础而闻名. 。 。 。

blocks.en: The total dataset consists of 7,388 pairs, of which 6,199 (84%) are English and 1189 (16%) are Danish. The pairs were collected and annotated in several stages. For the English texts, we sampled 5839 text pairs from a larger corpus of tweets about US politics Rasmussen and Petersen (2023) (after annotation, 5199 pairs remained). A further 500 text pairs each from Reddit and Gab were taken from a collection by Qian et al. (2019) . Different strategies were employed for collecting high-quality and relevant source data. While the Rasmussen and Petersen (2023) data were based on Twitter data from 2839 users whom they later surveyed, Qian et al. (2019) used hateful keywords to identify relevant conversations. The English texts were posted between 2008 and 2019, with most tweets dating from 2016 to 2019 and revolving mainly around American politics and Trump’s presidency.
blocks.zh: 总数据集由7,388对组成,其中英语为6,199对(84%),丹麦语为1189对(16%). 双方分几个阶段收集和注释。 对于英文文本, 我们从更多关于美国政治的推文中抽取了5839对文字(经过注释, 另外,Reddit和Gab各有500个文本对,取自Qian等人的收藏(2019年). 在收集高质量和相关源数据方面采用了不同的战略。 虽然拉斯穆森和彼德森(2023年)的数据是基于他们后来调查过的2839名用户的Twitter数据,但Q等人(2019年)却使用仇恨的关键词来识别相关的对话. 英文文本在2008年至2019年间发布,大多数推文可追溯至2016年至2019年,主要围绕美国政治和特朗普的总统任期展开.

blocks.en:
The 1189 Danish texts were sampled from a larger collection of Danish tweets ( Rasmussen et al., 2024 ) collected using the official Twitter API and the R package academictwitteR Barrie and Ho (2021) . The dataset primarily consists of tweets posted by Danish individuals (i.e., excluding official and celebrity accounts). The Danish tweets were sampled and labelled in two stages (see data annotation below), with tweets dating from 2009 to 2022, though most from 2020 to 2022. This latter period encompassed several significant events, including the 2022 Danish general election. Most Danish tweets are likewise about politics; however, other casual topics also occur in the data.
A dataset overview is provided in Table 1 .
blocks.zh:
使用官方TwitterAPI和R包acritictwitteR Barrie和Ho(2021年)收集的更多丹麦推文(Rasmussen等人,2024年), 数据集主要包括丹麦个人张贴的微博(即不包括官方和名人账户). 丹麦的推文分两个阶段取样和贴标签(见下文数据注释),其推文从2009年到2022年,尽管大部分是在2020年到2022年. 后一个时期包括若干重大事件,包括2022年丹麦大选。 丹麦大多数推文同样涉及政治;
数据集概览见表1。

blocks.zh: 表1:数据集概览。

blocks.en: 3.2 Data Annotation
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 数据注释

blocks.en: English and Danish data were annotated separately following the same codebook, available as supplementary material. 2 2 2 Codebooks were identical except that the English version also included a separate labelling dimension (”tweet type”) that we dropped for Danish, as it proved unnecessary for this study The English annotation setup used Qualtrics software (Provo, UT), while Danish annotation was carried out using a Shiny app ( Chang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 英文和丹麦文数据分别按照同一编码本附加说明,作为补充材料提供。 2个 2 Codebook是相同的,但英文版也包含一个单独的标签维度("tweet type"),我们为丹麦人放弃了这个维度,因为它证明这个研究没有必要. English annotion setup 使用Qualtrics软件(Provo, UT),而丹麦语notation则使用Shiny app(Chang等人,2025年)进行.

blocks.en: The English dataset was coded by a team of five coders, with an initial training period covering the first 200 tweets. During this period, the five coders worked together with a broader team of researchers to iteratively improve the codebook and to discuss and resolve disagreements. The five coders were Danish political science students aged 20-25, all highly proficient in English (3 female, 2 male). The Danish dataset was coded by two separate teams. The initial batch of 189 tweets was coded by a research team at the Department of Political Science of Aarhus University as a proof of concept. The second batch of Danish tweets was coded by three Danish university students aged 20-24 (all female). These three coders were initially trained on a set of previously coded English tweets, and then further trained on a set of 150 Danish tweets, after which they met with the research team to discuss disagreements. All student coders were paid the standard rate for student assistants at Danish universities (approx. $18 per hour).
blocks.zh: 英文数据集由5位编码员组成的团队进行编码,初始培训期涵盖前200个微博. 在此期间,五位编码员与更广泛的研究人员团队合作,迭代改进了代码本,并讨论和解决分歧. 5名编码员是20-25岁的丹麦政治学学生,均精通英语(3名女性,2名男性)。 丹麦数据集由两个独立的团队编码. 首批189条微博由奥胡斯大学政治学系研究组编码,作为概念证明. 丹麦第二批微博由三位20-24岁的丹麦大学生(均为女性)编码. 这三位编码员起初接受过一套之前编码的英文微博的培训,后来又接受过150个丹麦微博的进一步培训,之后他们与研究团队会面讨论分歧. 所有学生编码员都领取丹麦大学学生助理的标准费率(大约每小时18美元)。

blocks.en: The coders were instructed to determine whether each text contained hateful (yes, no, unclassifiable) and/or constructive (yes, no, unclassifiable) elements, as well as to classify agreement (agree, disagree, unclear) relative to its reference (parent) text.
blocks.zh: 已指示编码者确定每个文本是否包含仇恨(是、否、不可分类)和(或)建设性(是、否、不可分类)要素,并将协议(同意、不同意、不明确)与其参考(父母)文本进行分类。

blocks.en: Table 2: Class distribution across languages and annotation dimensions. Y = Yes, N = No, U = Unclassifiable for constructive speech and hateful; A = Agree, D = Disagree, U = Unclear for agreement.
blocks.zh: 表2:各语言的分类分布和注释维度。 Y=是,N=为 不,U = 无法进行建设性演讲和仇恨;A = 同意,D = 不同意,U = 不同意。

blocks.en: Hateful elements are defined as any expression of a motivation to degrade, harass, or intimidate individuals or collectives based on political differences or discriminatory views. In practice, annotators relied on a set of guiding principles: (i) demeaning or dehumanizing language directed at individuals or groups (e.g., insults or derogatory labels) is typically considered hateful; (ii) explicit statements of hate toward a person or group are labeled as hateful, unless clearly used in a non-literal or ironic manner; (iii) the use of slurs or highly uncivil language is often indicative of hate; and (iv) merely accusing someone of being hateful does not in itself constitute hate unless accompanied by other degrading elements.
blocks.zh: 仇恨内容被定义为基于政治分歧或歧视性观点而贬低、骚扰或恐吓个人或集体的任何动机。 在实践中,注解者依赖一套指导原则:(一) 贬低或非人性化的针对个人或群体的语言(如侮辱或贬低标签)通常被认为是仇恨的;(二) 对个人或群体的明确仇恨声明被贴上仇恨的标签,除非明显以非文学或讽刺的方式使用;(三) 使用流言蜚语或极不文明的语言往往表明仇恨;(四) 仅仅指责某人是仇恨本身不构成仇恨,除非伴有其他有辱人格的内容。

blocks.en: Constructive elements imply a prosocial attitude, signaling disapproval of hateful or hostile behavior, or aiming to side with, shield, or comfort an individual victim or victimized group. These include responses that aim to promote more respectful discourse or provide reasoned criticism. However, unsupported accusations (e.g., labeling someone as racist without justification) are not considered constructive, whereas reasoned arguments explaining such claims are.
blocks.zh: 建设性因素意味着一种亲社会态度,表明不赞成仇恨或敌对行为,或旨在支持、保护或安慰个别受害者或受害群体。 其中包括旨在促进更相互尊重的言论或提供合理批评的反应。 然而,无根据的指控(例如,无正当理由地将某人称为种族主义者)不具有建设性,而解释这种指控的理性论点则具有建设性。

blocks.en: Importantly, these two categories are not mutually exclusive, meaning that a single text can simultaneously contain both hateful and constructive elements. The texts that could not be meaningfully classified as containing either hateful or constructive elements were labeled unclassifiable.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,这两个类别并非相互排斥,也就是说,单一案文可以同时包含仇恨和建设性内容。 无法有意义地归类为含有仇恨内容或建设性内容的案文被贴上不可分类的标签。

blocks.en: In addition, annotators labeled agreement (agree, disagree, unclear) with respect to the reference text. This label captures whether the reply aligns with the stance of the reference. Agreement is interpreted at the level of intent rather than surface form (e.g., ironic agreement is coded as disagreement). Unlike hate and constructiveness, which can co-occur, ,agreement labels are mutually exclusive, and unclear or mixed cases are labeled “unclear”.
blocks.zh: 此外,注释者在提及案文时标注协议(同意、不同意、不明确)。 此标签可以捕捉回复是否与引用的位置一致 。 协议按意向而非表面形式来解释(例如,讽刺性协议被编码为分歧). 与仇恨和建设性(可能共同掩盖)不同,协议标签是相互排斥的,不明确或混合的案件被贴上“不明确”的标签。

blocks.en:
For the English Twitter data containing 5,839 pairs, each text pair was coded by at least three coders.
Inter-rater agreement for the different dimensions was relatively low (Krippendorff’s alpha: hateful: 0.46; constructive: 0.45; agreement: 0.50), reflecting the well-documented difficulty of the task ( Fonseca et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ) . Disagreements in assigned labels were resolved by majority vote, with examples showing three-way ties excluded (resulting in a final sample of 5,199 tweets). The 1,000 Reddit and Gab data was later coded by a single coder from the initial team of five coders. This was done because this data was pre-selected to be prosocial responses to hate speech by Qian et al. (2019) , meaning that the coding mainly served to check whether the definitions used in this current study aligned with the conceptualizations of hateful and constructive counterspeech employed by Qian et al. (2019) .
blocks.zh:
对于包含5,839对的英文Twitter数据,每对文本至少由3个编码器编码.
不同层面的学界间协议相对较低(Krippendorff的α:仇恨性:0.46;建设性:0.45;协议:0.50),反映了任务中有充分记载的困难(Fonseca等人,2024;Zhang等人,2023). 分配标签上的分歧通过多数投票解决,排除了显示三方联系的例子(最终样本为5,199个推特)。 1000 Reddit和Gab的数据后来由来自最初的5个代码组的单一编码器编码. 之所以这样做,是因为这一数据被预选为对Qian等人(2019年)的仇恨言论的亲社会反应,这意味着编码主要是为了检查本研究中使用的定义是否与Qian等人(2019年)采用的仇恨和建设性反言论的概念一致.

blocks.en: For the larger Danish dataset containing 1,000 pairs, three trained coders annotated the data, such that each text pair was coded by all three coders. Inter-rater agreement for the different dimensions was broadly similar to that for the English data (Krippendorff’s alpha: hateful: 0.58; constructive: 0.36; agreement: 0.55). Disagreements were first jointly assessed, with remaining undecided cases resolved by the data collection leader. The smaller Danish dataset containing 189 pairs was labelled by four researchers from the research group, with ties being jointly resolved.
blocks.zh: 对于包含1000对的较大的丹麦数据集,3个训练有素的编码器对数据进行注释,因此每个文本对都由所有3个编码器编码. 不同维度的学界间协议与英语数据大致相似(克里本多夫的α:仇恨:0.58;建设性:0.36;协议:0.55). 分歧首先由联合评估,其余未定案件由数据收集领导人解决。 研究组的4名研究人员将包含189对的较小的丹麦数据集贴上标签,并共同解决了联系问题。

blocks.en:
Class imbalance was identified across two dimensions (hateful and constructive). The imbalance is present both within each language subset and in the combined dataset. The majority class dominates in all cases. For example, non-hateful content constitutes approximately 77–85% of the data across languages, while hateful instances remain relatively scarce (10–16%). Similarly, non-constructive speech instances account for roughly 72–82%. Such class imbalance introduces a risk that models will disproportionately learn to predict the majority class, potentially achieving high overall accuracy while performing poorly on minority classes. This is particularly critical in tasks such as hate detection, where the minority class is often of greatest interest.
An overview of class imbalance is provided in Table 2 .
blocks.zh:
分两个方面(仇恨和建设性)确定了阶级不平衡。 每种语言子集和综合数据集都存在不平衡现象。 多数阶级在所有情况下都占主导地位。 例如,非仇恨内容约占各语言数据的77-85%,而仇恨事件则相对稀少(10-16 %)。 同样,非建设性言论约占72-82%。 这种阶级不平衡带来了一种风险,即模型会过度地学会预测多数阶级,有可能达到较高的总体准确性,同时在少数群体阶层表现不佳。 在诸如发现仇恨等任务中,这一点特别重要,因为少数群体往往最感兴趣。
班级不平衡概况见表2。

blocks.en:
The observed class imbalance is consistent with previous research showing that hateful and toxic content constitutes only a minority of online communication Gennaro et al. (2025a) ; Kantor (2020) .
At the same time, we believe our dataset contains a sufficient number of instances for the minority classes to enable meaningful model training and evaluation, balancing representativeness with practical usability.
blocks.zh:
所观察到的阶级不平衡与之前的研究表明仇恨和有毒内容在网络通信Gennaro等人(2025a)中只占少数;Kantor(2020).
与此同时,我们认为,我们的数据集载有足够数量的少数群体课程实例,以便能够进行有意义的示范培训和评估,兼顾代表性和实际可用性。

blocks.en: 3.3 Classifier base models
blocks.zh: 3.3 分类基准模型

blocks.en: We conducted experiments using four pretrained multilingual encoder-based language models (all openly available via Hugging Face):
blocks.zh: 我们使用四个经过预先训练的多语言编码器语言模型(都通过Hugging Face公开提供):

blocks.en: 1. XLM-RoBERTa-large Conneau et al. (2020) 2. multilingual-e5-large Wang et al. (2024) 3. Twitter-XLM-RoBERTa-base Barbieri et al. (2022) 4. mmBERT-base Marone et al. (2025)
blocks.zh: 1. XLM-RoBERTa-protect Conneau等人(2020年) 2. 多语种-e5-protect Wang等人(2024年) 3. Twitter-XLM-RoBERTa-base Barberi等人(2022年) 4. mmBERT-base Marone等人(2025年)

blocks.en: XLM-RoBERTa-large Conneau et al. (2020)
blocks.zh: XLM-RoBERTa大型Conneau等人(2020年)

blocks.en: multilingual-e5-large Wang et al. (2024)
blocks.zh: Wang等人(2024年)

blocks.en: Twitter-XLM-RoBERTa-base Barbieri et al. (2022)
blocks.zh: Twitter-XLM-RoBERTa-base Barberi等人(2022年)

blocks.en: mmBERT-base Marone et al. (2025)
blocks.zh: mmBERT-Base Marone等人(2025年)

blocks.en:
To support reproducibility, we supply the exact Hugging Face IDs and revisions in the appendix.
These models were selected for their strong multilingual capabilities and prior evidence of effective cross-lingual transfer without explicit language-specific training, enabling efficient knowledge transfer ( Barbieri et al., 2022 ; Conneau et al., 2020 ; Marone et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
为了支持可复制性,我们在附录中提供了准确的Hugging FaceID和修改.
选择这些模式是因为它们具有强大的多语种能力,而且事先有证据表明在没有明确的语言特定培训的情况下进行了有效的跨语言转移,从而能够有效地转让知识(Babieri等人,2022年;Conneau等人,2020年;Marone等人,2025年;Wang等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: We prioritized models that can be deployed locally with relatively low computational overhead, supporting practical applicability in real-world settings. For each base model, we fine-tune two variants: one using only the reply text, and one incorporating contextual information in the form of the reference (parent) text. This yields eight model configurations in total.
blocks.zh: 我们优先考虑可以在当地部署、计算费用相对较低的模型,支持在现实环境中的实际应用。 对于每个基本模型,我们细化了两个变体:一个只使用答复文本,另一个以参考(父母)文本的形式纳入背景信息。 这总共产生了8个模型配置.

blocks.en: Table 3: Model performance across constructive speech, hate speech, and agreement classification, evaluated with and without contextual enrichment. F1 scores are reported for each classification task alongside the average F1 score across tasks. Bold values indicate the best score in each category, with ties highlighted. For constructive speech and hate speech, Y = Yes, N = No, and U = Unclassifiable. For agreement, A = Agree, D = Disagree, and U = Unclear.
blocks.zh: 表3:无论是否丰富背景,对建设性言论、仇恨言论和协议分类的示范业绩进行评价。 每个分类任务的F1分数与任务平均F1分数并列. 粗体值表示每个类别中的最佳分数,并突出联系。 对于建设性言论和仇恨言论,Y=是,N=否,U=不可分类. 对于协议,A=同意,D=不同意,U=不明确.

blocks.en: 3.4 Task setup
blocks.zh: 3.4 国家 任务设置

blocks.en: The problem is formulated as three independent multi-class classification tasks for the three dimensions (hateful, constructive, agreement), each with three mutually exclusive labels (see data annotation section above).
blocks.zh: 这个问题是作为三个维度(仇恨、建设性、一致)的三个独立的多类分类任务拟订的,每个方面都有三个相互排斥的标签(见上文数据注释部分)。

blocks.en: The model produces a vector of nine logits for each input, which are partitioned into three groups of three, one for each task, and then converted into probabilities. At the prediction stage, the label with the highest probability within each group of logits is taken as the predicted label.
blocks.zh: 该模型为每次输入产生9个对数的矢量,它们被分成3组,每个任务各一组,然后转换为概率. 在预测阶段,每组对数中概率最高的标签作为预测的标签.

blocks.en: Model selection is based on the highest average validation accuracy across the three tasks. All base models are fine-tuned on the collected dataset and optimized through hyperparameter tuning.
blocks.zh: 模型选择基于三个任务中最高的平均验证精度. 所有基础模型均在所收集的数据集上进行微调,并通过超参数调试进行优化.

blocks.en: 3.5 Hyperparameters
blocks.zh: 3.5 超参数

blocks.en:
Models were trained using the same 80/20 training–validation split. Training was performed with a batch size of 16 for up to 20 epochs, with early stopping applied based on average validation performance (patience = 4 epochs). Optimization was carried out using AdamW with a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} and a weight decay of 0.1. The models were trained using a multi-task objective, computing the cross-entropy separately for each of the three classification tasks and averaging the three losses.
We used a plateau-based learning-rate decay Bottou (2012) , which reduced the learning rate by a factor of 0.5 after two epochs without improvement in validation loss, down to a minimum learning rate of 1 × 10 − 7 1\times 10^{-7} .
blocks.zh:
模式培训采用相同的80/20培训-认证分期进行。 培训的批量规模为16个,最长为20个学期,根据平均验证性能(patience = 4个学期)提前停止。 优化使用AdamW进行,学习速度为2×10−6 2\times 10×6}体重衰减0.1. 这些模型是使用一个多任务目标进行训练的,为三个分类任务中的每一个分别计算了交叉切入,并平均计算了三个损失.
我们使用基于高原的学习率衰减Bottou(2012年), 在两个纪元后将学习率降低0.5倍, 而验证损失却没有改善,

blocks.en: 3.6 Data preprocessing & tokenization
blocks.zh: 3.6 数据预处理和标识

blocks.en:
A simple preprocessing pipeline was employed. Usernames were replaced with @user, except for usernames appearing more than 100 times in the dataset (keeping public figures and prominent accounts). URLs were replaced with <link>. Emojis and hashtags were retained.
For non-context-enriched models, only the tokenized reply text was used as model input.
For context-enriched models, both the reference text and the reply text were tokenized and concatenated into a single sequence, separated by a [SEP] token, following prior work Hickey et al. (2026) ; Yu et al. (2022) . The maximum sequence length was set to the default of 512 tokens for all models. The average length of reply texts was 32 tokens, while the average length of concatenated reference–reply pairs was 84 tokens.
blocks.zh:
使用了简单的预处理管道。 用户名被替换为@user,但用户名在数据集中出现超过100次(保留公共人物和显著账户)除外. URL被替换为<link>. Emojis和标签被保留。
对于非文本浓缩的模型,仅使用象征性的回复文本作为模型输入.
对于内容丰富的模型,参考文本和答复文本都是以一个[SEP]符号分隔成单一序列的,之前的工作是Hickey等人(2026年);Yu等人(2022年)。 最大序列长度被设定为默认所有模型的512个令牌. 答复文本的平均长度为32个令牌,而缩合的参考文本的平均长度为84个令牌。

blocks.en: 3.7 Results
blocks.zh: 3.7 结果

blocks.en: We report F1-scores for each dimension (hateful speech, constructive speech, and agreement), alongside the weighted average, in Table 3 . Confusion matrices for all models are provided in the Appendix. The supplementary materials also include detailed classification reports with precision, recall, and F1-scores for all classes and labels.
blocks.zh: 我们报告每个层面的F1-分数(仇恨言论、建设性言论和协议),以及加权平均数,见表3。 附录提供了所有模型的迷惑矩阵。 补充材料还包括详细分类报告,精确、召回,以及所有类别和标签的F1-分数。

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Overall, the models achieved strong classification performance across all three tasks, indicating that multilingual language models can effectively detect hate speech, constructive speech, and agreement.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这些模型在所有三项任务中都取得了强大的分类性能,表明多语言语言模型能够有效检测仇恨言论,建设性言论和一致.

blocks.en: Performance was lowest for the agreement task, suggesting that agreement and disagreement are more difficult to identify than hate and constructive speech. Across tasks, the unclassifiable/unclear labels were the most challenging to predict, followed by the positive ("yes") labels. Incorporating the reference text resulted in only marginal and inconsistent improvements across models and tasks.
blocks.zh: 协议任务的业绩最低,表明协议和分歧比仇恨和建设性言论更难确定。 在任务中,不可分类/不明确的标签是最难预测的,其次是正(是)标签。 纳入参考文本只导致模型和任务之间略有改进和不一致。

blocks.en: The findings indicate that multilingual language models can be used to monitor both hate speech and constructive speech at scale. This could enable researchers to examine the prevalence of hateful and constructive content, as well as their dynamics and interaction within online discussions.
blocks.zh: 调查结果表明,可以用多种语言模式大规模地监测仇恨言论和建设性言论。 这将使研究人员能够审查仇恨和建设性内容的普遍程度及其在在线讨论中的动态和互动。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we collected and annotated a diverse social media dataset of reference–reply text pairs for joint detection of hate speech, constructive speech, and agreement in English and Danish. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first annotated dataset that jointly annotates all three dimensions in a non-exclusive framework and the first dataset for Danish constructive speech detection.
blocks.zh: 以共同侦测仇恨言论、建设性言论, 据我们所知,这是第一个附加说明的数据集,它共同在非排他性框架内对所有三个维度进行注释,也是第一个用于丹麦建设性语音检测的数据集。

blocks.en: We fine-tuned four multilingual transformer models in both context-enriched and non-context-enriched settings. Overall, the models achieved strong classification performance, with average F1 scores ranging from 78.6% to 82.0%. The effect of including conversational context varied across models: three models showed only marginal improvements, whereas Twitter-XLM-RoBERTa-base showed a decrease of 2.0 percentage points. The best-performing configuration was multilingual-e5-large with context, reaching an average F1 score of 82.0%, compared to 81.6% without context.
blocks.zh: 我们精细地调整了四种多语种变压器的型号,既包括上下文的变压器,也包括非文字的变压器。 总的来说,这些模型实现了强的分类性能,F1的平均分数从78.6%到82.0%不等. 包含对话背景的效果因模型而异:三种模型仅显示微小的改善,而Twitter-XLM-RoBERTa-base则显示下降了2.0个百分点. 最佳的配置是多语种-e5型,按上下文排列,平均F1分达到82.0%,而无上下文的为81.6%。

blocks.en: These findings generally point to the potential of multilingual language models for large-scale and non-exclusive detection of hate speech, constructive speech, and agreement, including for Danish. The dataset and models presented here provide a foundation for future research and practical applications aimed at monitoring online discourse and analyzing the dynamics between hate speech and constructive responses on social media.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果普遍表明,多种语言模式有可能大规模和不排斥地发现仇恨言论、建设性言论和协议,包括丹麦语。 这里介绍的数据集和模型为今后旨在监测网上言论和分析仇恨言论与社交媒体建设性反应之间的动态的研究和实际应用奠定了基础。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: This study has three main limitations. First, the models operate exclusively on text (and rely mostly on social media comments about politics), whereas hate speech and constructive speech are often expressed through multimodal content such as images, videos, and memes ( Chhabra and Vishwakarma, 2023 ; Kiela et al., 2020 ; Yang et al., 2019 ) .
blocks.zh: 这项研究有三个主要局限。 首先,这些模型完全依靠文字(主要依靠社交媒体对政治的评论),而仇恨言论和建设性言论则经常通过多模式内容表达,如图像、视频和meme(Chhabra和Vishwakarma,2023年;Kiela等人,2020年;Yang等人,2019年).

blocks.en: Second, the annotation scheme relies on relatively broad labels (e.g., yes/no/unclassifiable), which do not distinguish between different types or strategies of hate speech and constructive speech, that have been theorized to be of varying effectiveness ( Albanyan and Blanco, 2022 ; Albanyan et al., 2023 ; Yu et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 其次,注解计划依赖于相对宽泛的标签(如是/否/不可分类),这些标签不区分仇恨言论和建设性言论的不同类型或策略,这些标签被理论认为具有不同的效力(Albanyan和Blanco,2022年;Albanyan等人,2023年;Yu等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: Third, the dataset includes only English and Danish data. While the multilingual models used in this study have demonstrated strong cross-lingual transfer capabilities, the results can be expected to be most reliable for these two languages.
blocks.zh: 第三,数据集只包括英语和丹麦语数据. 虽然本研究中使用的多语种模型显示出强大的跨语种传导能力,但可以预计,对这两种语言而言,结果最可靠.

blocks.en: Future work could address these limitations by incorporating multimodal data or utilize natively multimodal models, developing more fine-grained classification schemes, and extending or evaluating the approach to additional languages and cultural contexts.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作可以通过纳入多式联运数据或利用本土的多式联运模式,制定更加精细的分类计划,以及扩大或评价其他语言和文化背景的做法,来克服这些局限性。

blocks.en: Table 5: Jev specification. Each question received the reference – reply pair as input state; the instruction and the class definitions (criteria) were the only task-specific input.

blocks.en: To evaluate our model performance against recent, state of the art classifier models, we used Jev (version 1.13) ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) to classify all of our model training data on the dimensions outlined above (hateful, constructive, agreement). We settled on Jev since it is fast, cheap, works as multilabel classifier, and can be used as a zero-shot classifier, thus promising to provide a classification infrastructure at scale without the need for expensive training data.
blocks.zh: 为了比照最新,最先进的分类器模型来评价我们的模型性能,我们使用Jev(第1.13版)(TypeSafe AI,2026)来分类我们所有关于上述维度的模型培训数据(仇恨,建设性,一致). 我们定居在Jev上,因为它是快速的,廉价的,作为多标签分类器工作,并且可以作为零镜头分类器使用,从而有望提供规模化的分类基础设施而不需要昂贵的培训数据.

blocks.en: We ran Jev on 14 October 2026 on all 7,388 reply–reference pairs (6,199 English, 1,189 Danish). Each pair was passed to Jev as a JSON object with two fields, reference (the original post) and reply , mimicking the context-enriched scenario, together with three independent choice questions, one per dimension (Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们于2026年10月14日对所有7,388份答复的参考对(6,199份英文、1,189份丹麦文)进行了调查。 每对被传递给Jev,作为JSON对象,包含两个字段,参考(原帖子)和回复(英语:Reference),模仿了上下文丰富的情景,加上三个独立的选择问题,每个维度一个(表5).

blocks.en: Each choice question consists of an instruction , which poses the annotation question and refers to the two fields by name, and criteria , which define the possible answers in plain language. As in the human annotation, every question has a third, residual class ( unclassifiable or unclear ). The questions were sent in a single request, answered independently of one another, and we took the class with the highest probability as Jev’s prediction. The English instructions were used unchanged for both languages. We provided no labelled examples and did no prompt tuning, and instead relied on the codebook for task definitions.
blocks.zh: 每个选择题都包含一个指令,它提出注释问题,并按名称提及两个字段,以及标准,它用简单的语言定义可能的答案. 和人类注释一样,每个问题都有第三个,剩余类(不可分类或不明确). 这些问题都是在一个单一的请求中发出的,彼此独立回答,我们把班级的概率最高作为Jev的预测. 两种语言均使用英文说明。 我们没有提供标有标签的例子,也没有及时调试,而是依靠代码表来界定任务。
